g.title: W2PX
g.text: M22759/33-28; each SA+ twisted with an SA- (back-wired string); 0.55 A Isc on two wires per pole, 18 mV

g.title: TB_W1
g.text: termination tab TB-W1 (hinge flex of wing W1)

g.title: W2W1
g.text: hinge-side strip HS(+X); twisted groups front (1, 2, 5), back (3, 4, 6), (7, 8); returns 0.37 A each

g.title: TB_W2
g.text: termination tab TB-W2 (hinge flex of wing W2)

g.title: W2W2
g.text: from the -Y end of TB-W2 up the (-X, +Y) bundle, z -34 ... -10 (HS(-X) holds the W2 sensor-splice pair), then under the EPS to J9 (zone Z5)
